However, block-new-docs.sh and memory-persistence scripts remain unwired because they live in hooks.json, which Claude Code ignores as settings.

I found that `.devin/skills/git-guardrails` is not installed. Ten concrete pain points emerged for hook-based fixes:

- False DoD completions from stop prompts
- Unauthorized edits to `.env`, `DATABASE_URL`, or lockfiles
- Unenforced markdown link rules
- Stale `SessionStart` dumps from oversized planning files
- Missing PostCompact re-injection of `GOAL.md` and current tickets
- Inconsistent formatting across app directories
- Absent `CwdChanged` or `direnv` handling for monorepo subprojects

Additional gaps surfaced. Auth-public API routes lack security guidance. Neon and Linear MCP integrations are missing from Claude Code’s .mcp.json. The .agents/skills directory holds 167 files while .claude/skills holds 13, so Claude Code likely cannot discover the full skill set.

The architecture review reveals three disconnected Python RAG apps, two live AI paths, concurrent multi-agent access to a shared tree, and a mixed package manager stack. Visual DoD serves as the actual quality bar, Linear owns tickets, and Neon is the data layer.

The first recommendation targets MCP: Neon must be added to Claude Code’s .mcp.json because it is the core database integration.

Agents currently guess database schemas or use raw SQL via packages/db/.env. Linear MCP is missing from Claude Code because tickets are Linear-owned and /goal accepts Linear IDs. Context7, Playwright, and GitHub are already covered by existing integrations. Vercel MCP could handle deployments.

A `create-migration` skill should be added for Neon and Postgres raw SQL migrations. Frontend-design is unnecessary because the design canon and research-ui-agent already cover UI work.

A `FileChanged` hook on `packages/db/.env` should trigger `CwdChanged` or `direnv` logic. A stop-prompt hook should prevent false DoD completions.

A security-reviewer would audit public API routes and enforce auth guidance. The security-guidance plugin should cover the documented auth-public API route gap.

## Claude Code Automation Recommendations

Top 1–2 per type. This repo already has more automation than it uses. The wins are wiring and enforcement, not another skill pack.

### Codebase Profile
- **Type**: Turbo monorepo — TypeScript (Bun/pnpm) + Python 3
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 / React 19 (`apps/app`), Disclosure Lab (`apps/disclosure-lab`), disconnected FastAPI/Streamlit RAG (`apps/disclosure-rag`)
- **Key Libraries**: `@db/postgres` (Neon 17 + pgvector), Clerk (middleware incomplete), Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Assistants, Firecrawl, Exa, React Flow, Three.js
- **Already wired**: context7, chrome-devtools, openai-vector-store MCP; SessionStart dump of `AGENTS.md` / `TODO.md`; compact-suggest; `log-pr.sh`; PreCompact git snapshots
- **Dead on disk**: [`block-new-docs.sh`](.claude/hooks/block-new-docs.sh) (only listed in [`hooks.json`](.claude/hooks/hooks.json), which Claude Code does not load), memory-persistence scripts, [`.devin` git-guardrails](.devin/skills/git-guardrails-claude-code/SKILL.md) (and that script still allows `git stash`)

---

### MCP Servers

#### Neon (official plugin)
**Why**: Every live read path goes through `@db/postgres`. Claude Code’s [`.mcp.json`](.mcp.json) has no Neon. Cursor already does. Agents guess schema or read gitignored env files.
**Install**: `/plugin install neon@claude-plugins-official`  
or `claude mcp add --transport http neon https://mcp.neon.tech/mcp`

#### Linear (official plugin)
**Why**: Tickets are Linear-owned. [`/goal`](.agents/skills/goal/SKILL.md) already accepts `DMGD-*` via raw GraphQL. A project MCP removes the curl/key dance and keeps `/loop` on the same issue.
**Install**: `/plugin install linear@claude-plugins-official`

Skip adding context7 or Playwright. Both are already present (chrome-devtools covers the DoD browser gate).

---

### Skills

#### lane-router
**Why**: Three apps, one of them explicitly disconnected. Agents still cross the boundary and invent AI paths. A Claude-only skill should pin workspace → nested `CLAUDE.md` → refuse cross-app work.
**Create**: `.claude/skills/lane-router/SKILL.md`
**Invocation**: Claude-only

```yaml
---
name: lane-router
description: Pin work to apps/app, apps/disclosure-lab, apps/disclosure-rag, or packages/*. Refuse cross-app edits unless the user named both.
user-invocable: false
---
```

#### dod-report
**Why**: [`.agents/rules/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md`](.agents/rules/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md) is binding and still skipped. A user-only skill that fills the evidence table + visual-audit rows is the only honest closeout.
**Create**: `.claude/skills/dod-report/SKILL.md`
**Invocation**: User-only

```yaml
---
name: dod-report
description: Fill the DoD completion report from git diff, test output, and browser audit. Mark UNVERIFIED if no visual pass.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
```

---

### Hooks

Put these in [`.claude/settings.json`](.claude/settings.json). Per the [hooks guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide): `PreToolUse` can deny even in bypass mode; after compaction, re-inject via `SessionStart` matcher `compact`, not `PostCompact`.

#### shared-tree-guard
**Why**: 2026-07-12 — a swarm `git stash` reverted four live files. `AGENTS.md` forbids stash. Nothing blocks it. The Devin script also misses `git stash`.
**Where**: `.claude/settings.json` → `PreToolUse` / `Bash`

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "if": "Bash(git *)",
            "command": "\"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR\"/.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-git.sh"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Add `git stash` (all variants) to the deny list before installing.

#### protect-files (wire the script you already wrote)
**Why**: `block-new-docs.sh` is correct and unused. Extend the same PreToolUse group to `.env`, `packages/db/.env`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
**Where**: `.claude/settings.json` — copy the `Write` matcher from [`.claude/hooks/hooks.json`](.claude/hooks/hooks.json) into `settings.json`. Claude only reads settings files, plugin `hooks.json`, and skill/agent frontmatter.

Separately worth doing, not in the top two: replace the SessionStart 2k-char dump of `AGENTS.md` + stale `TODO.md` with `GOAL.md` + `git branch` + `git status --porcelain`. Add a `compact` matcher that re-injects those three lines. Official guidance: that is the channel that actually reaches the model after compaction.

---

### Subagents

#### dod-auditor
**Why**: Completion theater is the repo’s documented failure mode (green tests, nobody opened the app). A read-only agent that scores the turn against both DoD gates, in parallel, before anyone says done.
**Where**: `.claude/agents/dod-auditor.md`

#### security-reviewer
**Why**: [`docs/architecture/API_ROUTES.md`](docs/architecture/API_ROUTES.md) — live AI routes are public. Clerk middleware is incomplete. This is not theoretical.
**Where**: `.claude/agents/security-reviewer.md`

Do not add another “app expert.” You already have five workspace agents; [`app-agent`](.claude/agents/apps/app-agent.md) still cites `docs/PLANS` and dead product myths.

---

### Plugins

#### security-guidance
**Why**: Same auth gap. Official plugin reviews each edit in-session ([marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/discover-plugins)).
**Install**: `/plugin install security-guidance@claude-plugins-official`

#### typescript-lsp
**Why**: RUNBOOK: large TS debt, Next build bypasses typecheck. LSP gives definition/reference/error on the file just edited. Pair with `pyright-lsp` only if you spend real time in `disclosure-rag`.
**Install**: `/plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official`  
Needs `typescript-language-server` on PATH.

---

## How to use automations on this architecture

The stack is three poorly coupled surfaces on one dirty tree. Automations only help if they match the failure mode.

1. **Hooks for rules that already failed as prose.** Stash, new `.md`, `.env`, lockfiles, “don’t claim done.” The [hooks guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide) is explicit: hooks are deterministic; the model does not get to skip them. `if: "Bash(git *)"` keeps the guard off unrelated shells.

2. **Skills for workflows you actually invoke.** `/goal` and `/loop` are the closed loop. Put new skills in `.claude/skills/`. The 42 files under [`.agents/skills/`](.agents/skills/) are Cursor/cross-harness. Claude Code will not auto-load them. That is why it feels like “we have skills” and sessions still ignore them.

3. **MCP for live state, not docs.** Neon schema and Linear issue body beat another 2k of `TODO.md` (which still carries rewritten hashes). chrome-devtools is the DoD dogfood tool — use it, don’t add Playwright.

4. **Subagents for parallel review, not extra personas.** Five specialists is enough. Add auditors (DoD, security). Trim the existing agent files so they stop teaching false architecture.

5. **Session context should be small and current.** Right now SessionStart spends tokens on planning files that are months stale. Inject `GOAL.md`, branch, dirty paths. After `/compact`, the official pattern is `SessionStart` + `compact` matcher, not another `echo` on `PostCompact`.

6. **Concurrent agents → worktrees, not more rules.** You already have [`.claude/worktrees/`](.claude/worktrees/) and `WorktreeCreate` / `WorktreeRemove` hook events. A shared tree plus “never stash” is a ceasefire. Isolated worktrees is the actual DX fix.

7. **Format hooks stay scoped.** Prettier exists only at [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc). A repo-wide `npx prettier --write` will fight Python and packages that do not share that config.

**Want more?** Ask for a deeper cut on one category: more hooks, more MCP, or a full rewrite of the five workspace agents.

**Want these installed?** Say “wire the git + docs hooks” — that is ~20 minutes and does not touch product code.

Next: add `git stash` to a `PreToolUse` deny script and register it in [`.claude/settings.json`](.claude/settings.json).

Open the updated [proposal after workspace review](/Users/liamellis/.cursor/projects/Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/canvases/claude-automation-dx.canvas.tsx). **Do not install the original list as-is.**

Nine workspaces reviewed. Two items survive unchanged in intent. Eight need a lane split. Two drop as top priority.

## Verdict on the original proposal

| Original | After review |
|---|---|
| Git stash / hard-reset hook | **Keep**, rewrite the Devin script: add `git stash*`, **do not** blanket-block `git push` (`/loop` needs it) |
| Slim SessionStart + compact | **Keep**, retarget: `GOAL.md` does not exist. Inject **nested `CLAUDE.md` by cwd**, not 6k of `TODO.md` |
| Neon MCP | **Keep read-only** for db / lab / app. Drop from ai, ui, kb, design vault |
| Linear MCP | **Keep repo-wide**, ignore in leaf packages |
| lane-router | **Hold** until lab + db have `CLAUDE.md`. Current [db-agent](.claude/agents/packages/db-agent.md) is still a Xata expert |
| dod-report / dod-auditor | **Change**: one DoD template false-fails. Canvas ≠ `:3010` ≠ `dy` ≠ Storybook ≠ `SELECT count(*)` |
| Wire `block-new-docs.sh` as-is | **Hold**: would block graft nodes, KB transcripts, prompt `.md`, CSF stories, `*_PSUEDOCODE.md` |
| Protect `.env` | **Change**: Write/commit deny, **Read allow**. Blocking Read of [`packages/db/.env`](packages/db/.env) strands `getSql()` |
| Protect lockfiles | **Drop** as a top hook |
| typescript-lsp as default | **Drop** as repo-wide. Noisy on Next; irrelevant on Python/corpus |
| security-guidance | **Keep**, scoped. Do not auto-lock public AI routes (intentional until Clerk UI exists) |
| Worktrees as primary DX | **Change**: copy `.env`; Neon branch per writer; do not clone 404MB knowledge-base |

## What each workspace actually needs

1. **[app](12b30bb0-0e45-4cc4-81d5-d0495d46b789)** — invent-route guard on `apps/app/src/app/api/**` (only two live AI paths) + chrome-devtools dogfood of `/research-canvas`. Repo-wide Prettier is already wrong; config lives only in [`apps/app/.prettierrc`](apps/app/.prettierrc).
2. **[disclosure-lab](9ea62559-081b-442f-aa86-5f5a7fb7c152)** — nested `CLAUDE.md` first (none exists). Then a Bash guard against `curl …/api/confirm` / write SQL. Unauthenticated write APIs on `:3010`.
3. **[disclosure-rag](ae653ccd-c95f-424a-93b0-a61d6f8a06d6)** — cwd-aware SessionStart so Next.js canon stops flooding a disconnected Python lane. Deny bare `python`/`pytest` without `.venv`. Prefer pyright, not TS LSP. Nested graft hooks already tax every turn.
4. **[db](7fac894f-c5ff-4968-81e1-dfb059af0627)** — rewrite db-agent before any router. `bun run test:db` is false green. Schema SoT is `migrations/rebuild/0001` + unapplied `0002`, not `001_create_tables.sql` (`personnel` vs `key_figures`). Best extra: FileChanged on the schema quartet, not a SQL linter.
5. **[disclosure-ui](3be56bd6-40a2-4e2a-acfd-fcadf77964b9)** — do **not** hook `validate_tokens.py`; it skips `tokens.css` and reports 0 errors by construction. Need a TSX hex/`--ut-*` matcher. SessionStart must inject `DESIGN_REGISTERS.md` + `--du-*`, not root `DESIGN.md`.
6. **[ai](0f8c3a46-fa41-47fe-a1cc-0d4ae41467cc)** — drop Neon/DoD here. `block-new-docs` fights new prompts. README still advertises deleted `agents/`. Better: `prompts:validate` on edit + registry-drift check.
7. **[knowledge-base](dc1d7dc7-ad3e-49b3-853f-284938a28a3b)** — disk corpus, **zero** JS imports. Lab’s `@knowledge-base` dep is unused. `block-new-docs` would break `sources/**` intake.
8. **[openai-vector-store-mcp](68b996e1-e970-4b57-a607-4e87bd6d3a68)** — `.mcp.json` uses a hardcoded absolute `.venv` path. SessionStart still injects stale “MCP not registered” TODO text. Portable launch beats more skills.
9. **[design-references](219cb165-f7f7-4c25-bb88-e4095c2c7a3a)** — ~2.6GB nested-git vault. Exclude from SessionStart. Keep stash block (nested `.git` makes stash worse). Drop Neon/Linear/LSP/DoD.

## What was wrong with my first list

It treated a three-app monorepo as one Next.js repo. The expensive mistakes would have been: denying Read of the DB env, blocking `git push`, running DoD as a browser walk on Python/SQL work, and turning on `block-new-docs` without an allowlist.

## Ship first (about 80 minutes)

1. Rewrite git guardrail → add stash, keep force-push / `reset --hard`, allow normal `git push`
2. Cwd-aware SessionStart + `compact` matcher
3. Neon MCP **read-only** + `.env` Write-deny

Hold lane-router, dod-report, and `block-new-docs` until the nested pins and allowlists exist.

Next: say **wire the git + SessionStart hooks** if you want those three shipped in this repo.
